sources.entry: channels - Brings WebSocket, long-poll HTTP, and other async support to Django.

summary.one_liner: Channels is an official Django project that adds WebSocket, long-poll HTTP, background task offloading and other async support to Django apps.
summary.what_it_does: Extends Django with asynchronous protocol handling so projects can serve WebSocket and long-poll HTTP connections alongside regular request/response views. It uses Django design patterns and is built on a flexible underlying framework that allows customizing behaviour and writing support for custom protocols. The README points to external docs for installation and getting started. It is installed from PyPI as the "channels" package. Related sibling packages named in the README are Daphne (HTTP and WebSocket server), channels_redis (Redis channel backend), and asgiref (base ASGI library and memory backend).
use_cases: add real-time WebSocket features to a Django site
serve long-poll HTTP endpoints in Django
offload background tasks from Django requests
build chat or live-update features in Django
write custom async protocol handlers for Django
notable: Official Django Project with a documented deprecation policy
Supports WebSocket and long-poll HTTP in the Django design style
Pluggable channel backends such as Redis via channels_redis
Companion Daphne server for HTTP and WebSocket termination
caveats: Maintenance is best-effort; guaranteed time is only for security fixes
Requires Python 3.10 or newer and Django 5.2 or newer
Installation and getting-started details live in external docs, not the README
